playbooks.title: The eight moves
playbooks.summary: Eight things that make a set of notes act instead of sit there — each one the exact wording to paste into your assistant. Start here.

playbooks.title: Capture what you already consume
playbooks.summary: YouTube, Instagram and X turned into notes you can search, quote and argue with later — one loop, and the different lie each platform tells you.

playbooks.title: Research that survives being challenged
playbooks.summary: Research is not collecting links. Turn a real question into a decision that holds up when someone pushes back on it.

playbooks.title: Turn one real receipt into one honest post
playbooks.summary: Strong content does not begin with a viral hook. It begins with something real you did — this is how one receipt becomes a post.

playbooks.title: Turn one video into notes you can still argue with
playbooks.summary: For the video you saved weeks ago and still have not opened — a loop that gets the substance out of it in one pass.

playbooks.title: Ask your own notes first
playbooks.summary: You have already decided this. Your assistant has not read it. Memory your assistant actually re-reads before it answers.

playbooks.title: Evidence before you say it works
playbooks.summary: Your assistant told you it works — and your assistant is also the thing that built it. Receipts instead of reassurance.

playbooks.title: Decide once what it may do without asking
playbooks.summary: The question everyone asks first is whether the thing can be trusted. Draw the line deliberately, once, instead of at every prompt.

playbooks.title: Run a Content Radar on your niche
playbooks.summary: The guided version: one run turns your coding agent into a niche content researcher and hands back a ranked 7-day plan.

playbooks.title: Content Radar — the full prompt
playbooks.summary: The complete paste-able instruction set: trends, real search volume and CPC for up to 1,000 keywords, and a competitor's recent posts, priced as it runs.

playbooks.title: Content Radar — the one-page version
playbooks.summary: One paste, three legs, a ranked 7-day plan, and a JSON file that makes runs comparable.
